BrochureContent.Content:
Little Chantri, 21 Killiney Road, Dalkey, Co. Dublin.

An appealing, light-filled residence with generously proportioned accommodation, exceptional gardens and a superb location close to Dalkey, Killiney and Dún Laoghaire.

Little Chantri is a most attractive family home extending to approximately 177 sq. m. The residence offers well-proportioned rooms filled with wonderful natural light, creating a bright and welcoming atmosphere throughout.
Lovingly maintained over the years, the house provides three fine bedrooms, together with a wonderful attic room and bathroom. A superb wrap-around kitchen extension forms an impressive feature of the accommodation, providing a spacious and inviting setting for everyday family life and entertaining.

The property also enjoys sea views, adding further appeal to this desirable coastal home.

Gardens and Parking
The exceptional rear garden is a particularly impressive feature, especially for a property in such a prime location. A large lawn provides generous space for children, entertaining and outdoor relaxation, while a substantial garden shed offers useful additional storage.

To the front, a large cobble driveway provides ample off-street parking.

An Outstanding Location
Little Chantri enjoys a superb position within easy reach of Killiney, Dalkey and Dún Laoghaire, each offering excellent shopping, acclaimed restaurants and an extensive range of recreational amenities.

The coastal setting provides an exceptional lifestyle, with marine activities available at Dún Laoghaire Harbour, beautiful local beaches and superb walking routes across nearby Killiney Hill and Dalkey Hill. Dalkey Village and Fitzpatrick's Castle Hotel are also close at hand.
Excellent Transport Connections

The property is exceptionally well connected:
• The No. 59 bus route provides access to Dún Laoghaire.
• DART services are available from Glenageary and Dalkey.
• The LUAS at Cherrywood offers convenient access to the city centre and surrounding areas.
• The N11 and M50 are both easily accessible.
• The Aircoach departs hourly from Fitzpatrick's Castle Hotel, only a few minutes' walk away.

An Ideal Family Setting
Killiney Road is a wonderful location for young families and is within reach of many of South County Dublin's most highly regarded primary and secondary schools.

Nearby schools include Glenageary Killiney National School (Wyvern), Rathdown Junior School and Rathdown School, CBC Monkstown, Cluny and Loreto Abbey Dalkey. St. Andrew's College and Blackrock College are also readily accessible by DART.

Special Features
• Spacious accommodation extending to approximately 177 sq. m
• Three fine bedrooms
• Wonderful attic room with bathroom
• Superb wrap-around kitchen extension
• Well-proportioned rooms with excellent natural light
• Sea views
• Two open fireplaces
• Burglar alarm system
• Gas-fired central heating
• New boiler installed in 2024
• Double-glazed windows
• Excellent off-street parking
• Large cobble driveway
• Exceptional rear garden with expansive lawn
• Fine garden shed
• Short walk from Killiney Hill Park
• Close to Dalkey Village and Fitzpatrick's Castle Hotel
• Convenient to Killiney, Dalkey and Dún Laoghaire
• Served by the No. 59 bus route
• DART stations at Glenageary and Dalkey
• Easy access to the LUAS, N11 and M50
• Surrounded by excellent primary and secondary schools

Little Chantri combines generous accommodation, outstanding gardens and excellent connectivity in a highly sought-after coastal setting, making it an ideal home for family life.
